name.value: Grimm's Gourmet & Deli Ltd & Brooklyn's Pizza

description.value: Grimm's Deli is a family-owned landmark in downtown Pemberton that has served the community for over 27 years, offering all-day breakfast featuring locally sourced Pemberton potatoes, gourmet sandwiches, homemade soups, and Brooklyn's Pizza. The restaurant prides itself on ingredients sourced from the Sea to Sky Corridor and is known for its signature homemade cream puffs and Grandma's Hot Sauce. It is a beloved local gathering spot and a natural refuelling stop for cyclists passing through the Pemberton Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Grimm's Deli is an active, family-owned full-service restaurant in downtown Pemberton with dine-in, takeout, delivery, and catering, corroborating OSM indoor_seating and outdoor_seating tags. Takeout is explicitly stated on the website ('Delivery – Dine-In – Takeout – Catering'); no cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags. Phone (604-894-5303) and address (106-7433 Frontier Street) are consistent between OSM and website.
concerns: OSM name includes 'Brooklyn's Pizza' as a combined business name, while the website primarily brands itself as 'Grimm's Deli'; Brooklyn's Pizza is mentioned on the website only as a menu item (pizza), not as a co-equal trade name.
